end.title: End {name}?
end.body: PID {pid}. Unsaved data will be lost.

body.one: {count} process of {name} will be ended. Unsaved data will be lost.
body.other: All {count} processes of {name} will be ended. Unsaved data will be lost.

endTree.title: End the process tree of {name}?

body.one: PID {pid} and its child process will be ended. Unsaved data will be lost.
body.other: PID {pid} and its {count} child processes will be ended. Unsaved data will be lost.

endTree.bodyAlone: PID {pid} has no child processes. Only this process will be ended.

partial.one: Ended {count} process; {failed} couldn't be ended (access denied or already exited).
partial.other: Ended {count} processes; {failed} couldn't be ended (access denied or already exited).

error.accessDenied: Couldn't end {name}: access denied. Turn on the privileged service in Settings, or run Argus as administrator. Protected processes may still not end.
error.critical: {name} is a critical system process. Ending it would crash Windows, so the action was blocked.
error.serviceOutdated: Couldn't end {name}: access denied. The privileged service version is incompatible; update the service and try again.

priority.confirmBody: Realtime processes run ahead of system tasks. If one uses all processor time, the mouse and keyboard may stop responding.
priority.downgraded: Realtime priority needs administrator rights, so High was set instead.

partial.one: Changed the priority of {count} process; {failed} couldn't be changed (access denied or already exited).
partial.other: Changed the priority of {count} processes; {failed} couldn't be changed (access denied or already exited).

priority.done: The priority of {name} has been set to “{priority}”.

ioPriority.failed: Couldn't change the I/O priority of {name}

partial.one: Changed the I/O priority of {count} process; {failed} couldn't be changed: {error}
partial.other: Changed the I/O priority of {count} processes; {failed} couldn't be changed: {error}

ioPriority.done: The I/O priority of {name} has been set to “{priority}”.

memoryPriority.failed: Couldn't change the memory priority of {name}

partial.one: Changed the memory priority of {count} process; {failed} couldn't be changed: {error}
partial.other: Changed the memory priority of {count} processes; {failed} couldn't be changed: {error}

memoryPriority.done: The memory priority of {name} has been set to “{priority}”.

on.failed: Couldn't turn on Efficiency mode for {name}

partial.one: Turned on Efficiency mode for {count} process; {failed} couldn't be changed (access denied or already exited).
partial.other: Turned on Efficiency mode for {count} processes; {failed} couldn't be changed (access denied or already exited).

off.failed: Couldn't turn off Efficiency mode for {name}

partial.one: Turned off Efficiency mode for {count} process; {failed} couldn't be changed (access denied or already exited).
partial.other: Turned off Efficiency mode for {count} processes; {failed} couldn't be changed (access denied or already exited).

suspend.title: Suspend {name}?
suspend.body: All threads of PID {pid} will stop until it is resumed. Its windows stop responding and network connections may time out; some programs (games, apps with anti-cheat or self-protection) may fail.

bodyGroup.one: {count} process of {name} will stop until it is resumed. Its windows stop responding and network connections may time out; some programs (games, apps with anti-cheat or self-protection) may fail.
bodyGroup.other: All {count} processes of {name} will stop until they are resumed. Their windows stop responding and network connections may time out; some programs (games, apps with anti-cheat or self-protection) may fail.

error.accessDenied: Access denied. Turn on the privileged service in Settings, or run Argus as administrator; protected processes may still be out of reach.
error.serviceOutdated: Access denied. The privileged service version is incompatible; update the service and try again.
error.critical: {name} is a critical system process. Suspending it would make Windows stop responding, so the action was blocked.
error.stillSuspended: {name} may still be suspended: some threads couldn't be resumed, or their state couldn't be read. Try again.

ruleScope.title: Add a rule for all processes with this name?
ruleScope.body: Rules match the executable name {name}. The rule will apply to all processes with this name, across hosts and installation paths.

staleProcess: The process instance information is out of date. Refresh and try again.
